title: Pay and allowances of prisoner of war during inquiry into his conduct.–Where the conduct of
text:
65. Pay and allowances of prisoner of war during inquiry into his conduct.–Where the conduct of
any person subject to this Act when being taken prisoner by, or while in the hands of, the enemy, is to be
inquired into under this Act or any other law, the Director-General or any officer authorised by him may
order that the whole or any part of the pay and allowances of such person shall be withheld pending the
result of such inquiry.
